answer: Make honest participation cheap and duplication expensive by pricing identity in sequential work rather than headcount. Each account must continuously clear a memory-hard proof kernel whose steps cannot be parallelized, so one machine advances one chain at a time. An ocean of sybils spun from a single operator then starves: their proofs queue instead of multiplying, and earning weight tracks verified throughput. Fake accounts drift into a barren tundra of zero yield while real contributors keep producing.
